articles.title: 3 men found guilty of killing American and Australian brothers on surfing trip in Mexico - CBS News
articles.description: A local judge has found three men guilty of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend in Baja California, Mexico, in April 2024.
articles.content:
A local judge on Friday found three men guilty of the murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend in April 2024 in the Mexican state of Baja California.
